item.title: Drop Command
item.description:
Title: Drop Command
Genre: Action , Indie , Simulation , Strategy
Developer: PillBugGames
Publisher: PillBugGames
Release Date: Sep 28, 2026




About This Game

Mech combat at a grand scale : Engage in combined arms combat where you pilot any unit under your command. From small skirmishes to epic battles, conquer rivals as you build a stellar empire.

Drop into combat . Either alone, leading your squad, or commanding an army. Take part in the evolving battlefield, with fully destructible debris and unit wreckage.

Customize and level up your pilots as they gain experience. Build elite squads of battle hardened soldiers, or rush your opponent with disposable rookies. Personalize your empire and modify your Mech , Tank, VTOL, or Battle Armour to suit the mission at hand.

Wage war across the star cluster in a procedural campaign. Face logistic and tactical decisions as you vie for control of strategic resources, pivotal systems, manufacturing hubs, and political objectives.

Completed or failed mission objectives will have serious consequences as they impact future campaign operations. Champions will rise across the cluster, and establish pirate factions, mercenary companies, or even rival empires!

Conduct diplomacy with planetary governments and rivals. Strike a balance between empire growth and peaceful coexistence, or wage war without regard to the consequences...

item.title: Antivirus Survivors 2003 Professional
item.description:
Title: Antivirus Survivors 2003 Professional
Genre: Action , Casual , Indie , RPG
Developer: Shaun Hammond Business Solutions Limited
Publisher: Shaun Hammond Business Solutions Limited
Release Date: Sep 28, 2026




About This Game

Boot up, log on and prepare for intense double-clicking action.

In Antivirus Survivors 2003 Professional, double-click through folders as you dodge voids, fight viruses, evade spam pop-ups, and defeat bosses. Search for XP and keys by exploring the folders and opening files, completing tasks and policies for bonuses. Develop your build through upgrades and plugins, and unlock new weapons and styles of gameplay.

With intense rogue-like action and a deep love for early 2000s computer operating systems, this is a blast of pure Y2K nostalgia served in roughly 30-40 minute runs.

The full game includes:

  • 24 Weapons - Pinball, Solitaire, Mines, Firewall, and more inspired by the 2000’s computing era.

  • 50 Drivers - Transform how a weapon usually works with bespoke upgrades.

  • 33 File Types - Double-click on your favourite file types for rewards - LemWire, BigWave, Defrag and more.

  • 62 Plugins - Open keygens and install plugins to greatly modify weapons and player stats.

  • 18 Meta Upgrades - Choose wisely to shape your path through meta progression.

  • 5 Difficulty Levels - Five protocol folders with escalating risks and rewards.

  • 15 Policies - Unique challenges to experience the game in more difficult and interesting ways.

  • 18 Player Stats - Create unique builds when upgrading damage, speed, luck and more.

  • 81 Wallpapers and 8 Themes - Unlockable cosmetics to customise your desktop.

  • 6 Bosses and Mini Bosses - Supercharged enemies and powerful bosses to defeat.

  • 200+ Tasks - Complete extra tasks to unlock new Files, Weapons, Plugins and more!

Double-Click, Unzip, Download, Upgrade, Survive.

item.title: Bug Cleaners
item.description:
Title: Bug Cleaners
Genre: Adventure , Casual , Indie , Simulation , Early Access
Developer: dicehit
Publisher: dicehit
Release Date: Sep 28, 2026
Early Access Release Date: Sep 28, 2026




About This Game

🐛 Bugs are everywhere!
It's time to clean them up! Build your team or go solo—stop this invasion!

🔥 Burn them with the blowtorch!
Use the power of fire to burn the invaders to a crisp!

🦟 Spray them with the pesticide machine!
Force the bugs to disappear into the toxic mist!

🌀 Vacuum them up with the vacuum cleaner!
Suck them all up in one go and leave behind a pristine area!

🐱 Detect bugs with your trained cat, Sniffers!
Sniffers can sense bugs in any area it sniffs! With its warnings, every corner is ready to be cleaned. A fast and reliable helper—always by your side on this mission!

👣 Squish bugs with your hands, stomp them mercilessly with your feet!
Sometimes, getting the job done means squishing bugs in one swipe with your hands and stomping them with your feet—end for the bugs, relaxation for you!

🎯 Chaotic missions, absurd humor, fun cleaning!
Ready for the craziest cleaning experience, solo or with your team!

item.title: Deskrawl: Idle ARPG
item.description:
Title: Deskrawl: Idle ARPG
Genre: Action , Adventure , Casual , Indie , RPG
Developer: First Day Games
Publisher: First Day Games , Gamersky Games
Release Date: Sep 28, 2026




About This Game

Grind mobs, farm loot, and capture enemies to serve you. Deskrawl is an epic idle ARPG that plays at the bottom of your desktop. Farm legendary items and build overpowered heroes while you work or chill.

Desktop Idle ARPG

Idle farm legendary loot and push your power to broken extremes. Choose from a roster of heroes, each with their own playstyle, and mix gear, minions, and abilities until you reach a godlike build.

Own Minions

Enemies in Deskrawl can be captured, even Bosses! Your minions haul the loot cart so you never stop grinding, and they support you in combat too: some grant passive buffs, while others unleash special abilities.

Town Progression

Stockpile resources to grow your town from a quiet outpost into a thriving hub. Unlock new NPCs and services as you progress, each one opening up new ways to grow your power.

Trading

Trade valuable equipment, materials, and minions with other players on the Steam Market.

Mythic Realms

Test your hero in ultimate challenges, timed trials, and escalating difficulty tiers that push you to the limit. The deeper you go, the better the rewards.

item.title: Stranded with You
item.description:
Title: Stranded with You
Genre: Adventure , RPG , Simulation
Developer: Kumada Gaon
Publisher: Saikey Studios
Release Date: Sep 25, 2026




About This Game

You open your eyes and… find yourself on a desert island?!

You and your childhood friend, Mitsuki Nanami, had not kept in contact for many years. But one day, she invited you on a trip for summer vacation. While on the trip, your ship was caught in a great storm, and the two of you ended up stranded on a desert island.

Now you must explore, secure food and water, forage for supplies, and craft items in order to survive and escape the island. And through these shared hardships, your relationship with Mitsuki may begin to change.

Do all you can to survive on a desert island. Explore, create a shelter, search for supplies, fish, hunt, cut wood, mine, and much more. Train your stats and craft tools to increase your chances of success, discover new crafting recipes, and make your shelter feel a little more like home each day. But be careful not to overexert yourself, physically or mentally. This isn’t only your survival story, and Mitsuki is always there to help you.

Once you are ready, you can create a boat and attempt to escape the island. The journey will be difficult, but failure can open the door to new innovations.

Acquire Materials and Craft

In order to ensure your survival, you will need to acquire materials by exploring and completing various tasks. You can use these materials to craft new items and tools that will help you survive.

Increase Stats and Deepen your Bond

Increase your stats through training, and deepen your bond with Mitsuki through various actions at the shelter. Remember, you are not alone. Nanami’s assistance will be crucial.

Escape the Island

Survival isn’t the end goal; returning home is. Make a boat and attempt the gruelling journey back to civilization.

Recollection Room

View your special moments with Mitsuki at any time after unlocking them.
